p417.title: Enhance test_pass method with complex scenarios that can genuinely reveal bugs

nodes.body: @copilot+gpt-5.4 apply changes based on the comments in [this thread](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/pull/417#pullrequestreview-3035638976)

> @copilot+gpt-5.4 apply changes based on the comments in [this thread](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/pull/417#pullrequestreview-3035638976)

Applied the review-thread changes in 71a1619: removed the mock/patch-based utility checks, switched the tests to real `Goal` and `Action` objects, fixed the real `calculate_plan_utility` call signature, and clarified the goal-direction semantics used by these utility tests. Targeted unittest runs still pass, and CodeQL reported no alerts.

## Pull Request Overview

This PR enhances the `test_pass` method in `test_fix_validation.py` by replacing overly simplistic assertions with complex scenarios that exercise actual tiny_village functionality and can genuinely fail when underlying systems are broken. The enhancement moves beyond basic Python operations (arithmetic, string methods, list operations) to test realistic edge cases, boundary conditions, numerical stability, and system integration that could reveal genuine bugs in calculation logic, data handling, encoding, and component interactions.

- Enhanced test complexity with multi-attribute character state calculations and floating point precision testing
- Added advanced string processing with unicode handling and malformed data detection
- Implemented comprehensive data integrity validation with constraint checking and error recovery
- Added JSON serialization testing with unicode preservation and file I/O operations

### Reviewed Changes

| tests/verify_genuine_failures.py | Verification script proving enhanced tests can genuinely fail under realistic conditions with edge cases and system integration errors |

p408.title: Replace artificial test failures with genuine functional tests in test_fix_validation.py

This PR replaces artificial test failures with genuine functional tests in the test suite to address a violation of testing best practices. The original tests used `self.fail()` calls that created meaningless failures without validating real functionality.

p397.title: Fix test counting logic to properly count individual unittest methods instead of treating TestCase classes as single units

nodes.body:
## Pull Request Overview

This PR fixes a critical issue in test counting logic where unittest.TestCase classes with multiple test methods were being counted as single test units instead of counting individual test methods separately, leading to inaccurate test feedback and artificial manipulation of test results.

### Key Changes:
- Added `run_unittest_with_proper_counting()` utility function to correctly count individual unittest methods
- Updated main test runner to use proper counting and report granular results 
- Created comprehensive validation and demonstration files to verify the fix

### Reviewed Changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| tests/test_completed_implementations.py | Added utility function for proper counting and updated main() to count individual test methods |
| tests/test_fix_validation.py | Validation test suite that verifies the fix works correctly with various scenarios |
| tests/test_counting_demo.py | Demonstration file showing before/after behavior of counting logic |
| TEST_COUNTING_FIX.md | Documentation explaining the issue, solution, and benefits of the fix |

p395.title: Fix test_goap_implementations to test actual functionality instead of just method existence

nodes.body:
## Pull Request Overview

This PR fixes the `test_goap_implementations` function to test actual functionality instead of just checking method existence, addressing a violation of custom testing guidelines. The test was redesigned to use real test data and validate actual behavior rather than simply verifying that methods are callable.

### Key Changes:
- Replaced method existence checks with functional tests using mock objects and real data
- Added comprehensive testing of Plan and GOAPPlanner classes with proper input validation
- Implemented bug detection capabilities that discover real implementation issues


p391.title: Fix happiness calculation test to use flexible threshold instead of hardcoded exact match

nodes.body:
## Pull Request Overview

This PR converts the happiness calculation test from a simple function to a proper unittest framework with flexible threshold-based validation instead of implicit exact matching. The change improves test robustness by allowing tests to pass when at least 3 out of 4 happiness features are implemented, rather than requiring all 4.

- Refactored `test_happiness_calculation()` function into a `TestHappinessCalculation` unittest class
- Implemented flexible threshold validation (minimum 3 features) with proper assertions
- Added granular individual feature testing for better debugging feedback
